assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the CO-197 denial
CPT 93229 is Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring
The appeal is for diagnosis codes I49.5 and I49.9
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome
The symptoms are suggestive of unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
The symptoms are paroxysmal in nature
There is a need for continuous rhythm correlation over an extended period
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was ordered to capture and characterize the arrhythmic events
The payer letter invites supporting clinical documentation justifying medical necessity
The indication supports coverage of the $628.86 balance
